scope: Isolated two independent F9401 PRECAP0/1 modes. Original polynomial/reset/preset/falling-edge semantics retained verbatim. Matched50MHz negative-edge external staging/positive-edge launch/capture,20ns embedded paths,2ns max0ns min virtual I/O. Counts include shell/admin/pruning; no CRC behavior change/full board/global snapshot or speed claim.

manifest.scope:
Exact modeled F9401 CRC/PRECAP state in two bounded18-bit words.

Preserves all19bits, reset/preset/falling-edge order, setup history and the
original polynomial selection. Caller holds all consumers; no global barrier.
